wizard.title: New Project
wizard.description: Create a new spec workspace: where .md files live and the target NotebookLM notebook.

info.name: Project name
info.nameHint: Shown on the Projects screen and in the Workspace Switcher. Must be unique.
info.descriptionPlaceholder: Specs for the AI-assisted .md workbench synced to NotebookLM

storage.pathHint: Absolute path, writable and not used by another project.
storage.specsDirHint: Leave empty = spec files live at the working folder root.

gitToggle.label: Sync via Git
gitToggle.hint: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea or a Git URL.

driveToggle.label: Sync via Google Drive
driveToggle.hint: A Drive folder + a local copy.

gitDetected.title: This folder is already a Git repo
gitDetected.author: Commit author: {author}

git.hostHintDefault: Leave empty for {host}. Set a host for self-hosted servers.
git.connectViaHint: Connectors are managed in Settings › Integrations. Priority: CLI → MCP → Token → SSH.
git.sshDescription: Uses this machine's ssh-agent: clone/pull/push only, no repo listing and no PRs.
git.needsLogin: This connector needs to sign in again. Run the login command in a terminal, then Check it in Settings › Integrations.
git.repoHint: Listed from {source}. Type owner/repo if it isn't in the list.
git.publishMode: How changes are pushed after Approve
git.pushDescription: To the selected branch. Fast, good for personal repos.
git.prDescription: Create a branch from the template and open a PR/MR; approvals in one session share it.
git.prDisabled: Requires a CLI, MCP or Token connector for the provider.

autoPush.label: Push / open PR after commit
autoPush.hint: When off, use Push in the header when ready.

git.tokenDescription: Use a Personal Access Token to clone/pull/push (and open PRs if the token allows).
git.tokenHint: Needs repo read/write (GitHub: contents read/write; GitLab: read_repository + write_repository). Encrypted at rest, sent as a header only to this host, never written to the URL or .git/config.
git.tokenCheckFailed: Token saved but the check did not pass

google.connected: Signed in to Google · Drive access granted.
google.notConfigured: The server has no Google OAuth client (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET).

drive.folderHint: Paste the Drive folder URL or ID; the ID is extracted automatically.
drive.authHint: Shared with NotebookLM Drive Sync when it is the same account.

pullOnOpen.label: Download on open
pullOnOpen.hint: Fetch the latest files from Drive each time the workspace opens.

pushOnApprove.label: Upload after Approve
pushOnApprove.hint: Write approved files back to Drive.

notebook.notebookIdHint: Paste the notebook URL or ID; the ID is extracted automatically.

DRIVE_SYNC.title: Google Drive Sync
DRIVE_SYNC.description: Write specs as Google Docs, then refresh the source. Stable, recommended.

RPC.title: Direct Cookie RPC
RPC.description: Delete the old source and re-upload over RPC. Fast, but fails when cookies expire.

notebook.driveFolderHint: Drive folder holding the Google Doc copies of the specs.
notebook.rpcHint: Connect NotebookLM in Settings › Integrations (paste cookie) before syncing.
notebook.mapping: Mapping: each spec file ↔ one source with the same name in the notebook.

autoSyncOnApprove.label: Sync to NBL automatically after Approve Diff

notebook.checkLater: The notebook connection is checked right after the project is created.

review.name: Name
review.hint: Create Project creates the folder / clones the repo / downloads Drive, writes .spec-studio/config.json and adds it to Projects.

run.title: Progress
run.checkDescription: Folder, Git remote, Drive access, notebook
